title: LangChain Replaces Manual Trace Review with AI Search in LangSmith
summary:
Developers can now pinpoint specific agent failures or user dissatisfaction by entering plain-text descriptions into their system logs. LangChain's new AI Search feature for its LangSmith platform identifies and returns the specific interaction traces where a described event, such as a failed task or a subscription cancellation attempt, occurred.

The functionality was announced at the Interrupt conference. Before this update, locating these insights required developers to construct custom evaluators or manually scan through hours of conversation data to identify behavioral patterns in LLM applications.
